final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: 用 C# 泛型从零构建类型安全的管道，每个阶段声明输入输出类型，编译器在组装处拦截错误连接。The reader should quickly feel 每一段边界都有类型把关，接错线在编译期就被拦下。 Summary angle: 把「解析 → 校验 → 汇总」三段流程画成一条由编译器把关的发光轨道，每段边界有类型闸门。 Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration. Information blocks: - 问题：数据块沿流程线在每段边界改变形态与颜色，表示表示类型在变化，可见标签「解析」 - 机制：两个相邻的模块化闸门之间有清晰类型边界，光线穿过，可见标签「校验」 - 结论：终点处一枚清晰的通过标记，代表编译器完成类型把关，可见标签「汇总」。 Main metaphor: 一条架在云端、被戏剧性背光照亮的轨道式管道，数据像一束光依次穿过三段类型闸门。 Subject: 由三个发光模块组成的横向管道，光束从左向右流经闸门，在终点汇成发光标记。 Composition/framing: 轻微斜向推进，主焦点在管道中段边界，横向叙事在宽幅中保持可读。 Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: transparent blue skies, dramatic backlight, detailed clouds, youthful cinematic lighting, rain and reflection details, no artist imitation. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: 透明蓝、云白、暖金背光、青色点缀。 Visible text policy: allow only 3 short Chinese labels: 「解析」「校验」「汇总」，每个不超过 2 个汉字。No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: 代码雨、漂浮芯片、真实 IDE 截图、真实架构图节点名、霓虹高楼、紫色光污染、UI 面板。
